setlist_extra.title: This Could Be The Last Time

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Here Comes Sunshine** (3 reviews): Reviewer says Garcia gets only about half the words in on Sunshine; Sunshine placement here was unusual; reviewer says it was only the third time played since 12.6 in Tempe AZ [16][17][19]
- **Loser** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Loser hot, in a short but solid first set [11]
- **So Many Roads** (1 review): Reviewer singles out So Many Roads as nice, along with the Scarlet/Fire pairing [15]
- **Corrina** (1 review): Reviewer says Corrina rocks hard, even though they generally dislike the tune [10]
- **Baba O'Riley** (1 other source): Encore was Baba O'Riley into Tomorrow Never Knows [4]
- **Way To Go Home** (1 other source): Way To Go Home follows Scarlet-Fire, with Uncle John's, Playin' Reprise, Drums and a jam leading to The Last Time [4]

## Setlist highlights

- **Baba O'Riley**: rare: 12 archived performances [22]
- **Tomorrow Never Knows**: rare: 12 archived performances [22]

## The recordings

- **gd1992-12-17.mtx.tobin.87983.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 168 min; rated 2.67/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd1992-12-17.dts.tobin.88013.flac**: source not stated; 20 songs; 168 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1992-12-17.fob.neumann.copeland.gems.79732.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 176 min; rated 2.67/5 by 3 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds this audience recording best sounding, with solid playing throughout [21]
- **gd92-12-17.sbd-2track.stonebear.5552.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 166 min; rated 2.95/5 by 20 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the soundboard extremely sharp and pristine, with a powerful, train-like band sound; Reviewer says Garcia's guitar sounds somewhat acoustic after Healy was fired; Soundboard is clear but heavily noise-gated, leaving instruments weak, distant and clipped [10][13][16][17][19]

## Around the show

- Garcia is in fine form after his medical break, and Phil is especially strong, closing out the 1992 shows [11]
- Reviewer attended every show of the run except 12-11, and felt let down about missing 12-16 hype [15]
- Reviewer says Weir's voice is shot and Garcia fades, with a six-song first set [16]
- This show gets little notice compared with the previous night's show, which draws most of the attention from the run [11]
- Reviewer intends to seek out Dick's Picks 27, the previous night's show, after hearing this one [12]
- Reviewer prefers the second set to the previous night's and finds the first set throwaway [14]
- Solid show, but it does not live up to the hype that 12-16 received [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1992-12-17.mtx.tobin.87983.sbeok.flac16**: taped by See info file; transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 4 Source Mix (60%-SBD/40%-AUD) [1]. Also: Healy's two-track PA soundboard DAT master went to a cassette for Phil Lesh, which Dick Latvala confiscated; Audience source used Neumann KM140 microphones in ORTF, from Todd Evans' DAT collection, mastered by Jamie Waddell in 2006 [1]
- **gd1992-12-17.dts.tobin.88013.flac**: taped by See info file; transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: See info file [2]. Also: DTS mix aligned the soundboard and two audience sources, using Audition 2.0 [2]
- **gd1992-12-17.fob.neumann.copeland.gems.79732.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Chip Copeland; transferred by Todd Evans and Jamie Waddell; source: Neumann km140 (110 deg. ORTF) -> Neumann Supply -> Panasonic sv255 [3]
- **gd92-12-17.sbd-2track.stonebear.5552.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [5]. Also: Reviewer says the uploader's copy cuts Scarlet off right on its last lyric [17]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Sameh Tawfik Grateful Dead: [1992-12-16 Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum, Oakland, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1992-12-16-oakland-alameda-county-coliseum-oakland-ca-usa/) [23]
- Fan art by Sameh Tawfik Grateful Dead: [1992-12-16 Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum, Oakland, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1992-12-16-oakland-alameda-county-coliseum-oakland-ca-usa/) [24]
